query2.query: Show me step by step how to assemble the Chassis in Part 4 of the Airfix1 instruction manual. Refer to each part number and part name in your response.
query2.answer:
To assemble the chassis in Part 4 of the Airfix1 instruction manual, follow these steps:

1. Locate and cement upper angled ends of front springs (44, 45) into inner holes of suspension lugs beneath chassis frame (46).
2. Locate upper pivot pins of stub axles (47, 48) into outer holes in suspension lugs, noting that the track rod connections face forward and downwards. Locate the front cross member (49) beneath the chassis frame at the same time locating the lower ends of the springs and stub axles.
3. Locate and cement radiator support A" frame (51) to locations on the cross member and under the chassis.
4. Locate and cement boot liner (52) into locations on the rear of the chassis.
5. Position and cement wheel arches (53, 54) onto locations at the rear of the chassis.
6. Locate and cement radiator (55) into the front of the engine compartment (56) from outside.
7. Locate and cement left (57) and right (58) compartment sidewalls, inside locating ribs on the underside of the engine compartment sides. Note that ribs at the rear edge of the sidewalls should be located outside.
8. Locate and cement the completed interior assembly onto the chassis locations, ensuring that the ejector seat cylinder passes through the large hole on the passenger's left hand side of the chassis pan.
9. Locate and cement the completed engine radiator to the locations at the rear of the chassis.
10. Locate and cement the expansion tunnel (59) to the locations within the engine compartment.
11. Locate and cement the heating ducting (60) to the locations within the engine compartment, ducting angled across the left hand rear side of the compartment.
